extracted.intended_audience: ICCV 2023 reviewers, program committee members, and conference organizers involved in the review process
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative timeline of key dates and deadlines for submission, reviewer assignment, review completion, rebuttal/discussion, final recommendations, and author decisions for ICCV 2023. Specifies when each phase of the conference peer-review process begins or is due.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paper Submission Deadline
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deadline for authors to submit papers for ICCV 2023; all submissions must be completed by this date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Papers Assigned to Reviewers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Date when submitted papers are expected to be assigned to reviewers (start of the review period for reviewers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviews Due
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deadline by which reviewers must complete and submit their reviews for assigned papers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Start of Post-Rebuttal Discussion Period
rubrics_metrics.description: Start of Post-Rebuttal Discussion Period — June 1, 2023
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beginning of the period after author rebuttals when reviewers and area chairs/discussion participants engage in post-rebuttal discussion about papers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final Recommendations Due
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deadline for reviewers/area chairs/program committee to submit their final recommendations for each paper following discussions and rebuttal considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions Released to Authors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Date on which acceptance/rejection decisions are communicated to authors.
